question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement requires a word that indicates the continuation or initiation of an action or process in blank no. 3.
 
 
• **Example: **When you turn the device on, it immediately starts its calibration process.
 
 
 
• The correct word, **"on"**, typically indicates that something is in a state of operation or engagement. (चालू)
 
 
• **Example: **Make sure the lights are on before you leave the house.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that accurately fills in blank no. 3, suggesting that something is to be activated or in operation, is **'on'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Off** (बंद): Indicates that something is deactivated or not in operation.

 
 
• **Example:** Please turn the lights off before you go to bed.
 
 
 
• **Aside** (अलग): Indicates something being put to the side, either literally or figuratively.
 
 
• **Example:** She set her book aside and went to answer the door.
 
 
 
• **For** (के लिए): Used to indicate the purpose of an object or action.
 
 
• **Example:** This tool is used for cutting metal.
